description:
Execute a plan that a human has approved.

Runs only the legs carried in the signed plan. A plan can be run once — replay is
blocked in the database, not in code. Every leg writes a receipt BEFORE its call,
so a leg that never returns leaves a visible 'pending' rather than no trace at all.

Blog posts publish as DRAFT unless the plan explicitly said PUBLISHED: this writes
to a real client's public website, and straight-to-live means their audience
reviews the page before anyone else does.

planToken.description: The signed token returned by site_plan.

name: site_run
